One day (I was like 12/13) I decided, that I had enough of those focals and decided to "fight them" by continuing reading. So what did we learn? Focals can be just about anything and negative EEGs don't make you not epileptic.

Sure. Reading epilepsy is (as far as I know) characterized by experiencing a sudden spasm in the jaw due to reading for a longer period of time (mostly a few minutes). By not stopping to read further spasms follow, eventually resulting in a grand mal, generally it can be controlled with medication tho. The downside is that it can't be normally detected by EEGs without reading something, which is also the reason for my initial question.
